covenants.quote: 12.1 The Borrower shall ensure that the Debt Service Coverage Ratio shall not be less than 1.15 times during construction and shall not be less than 1.30 times after commercial operation.
12.2 Debt to Equity shall at no time exceed 3.00 times.
12.3 The Borrower shall maintain a Tangible Net Worth of not less than INR 1,200 crore.
13.1 The value of the Security shall at all times be not less than INR 3,600 crore, as certified by an approved valuer.
